page.title: VShojo
page.subtitle: Gods, aliens, and robots, oh my!
page.heroDescription: We’ve partnered with VShojo, the VTuber company taking the internet by storm. Each case is specially designed with the unique aesthetic of each member in mind, making them the perfect accessory for any fan wanting to show off their love for their favorite VTuber.

content.title: For the Fans
content.description: Each case features special peekers, emotes, and visual easter eggs that fans will love and recognize from their favorite VTuber.

content.title: Fandom-Fueled Technology
content.description: This steel chassis supports E-ATX, ATX, micro-ATX, mini-ITX, up to 360mm radiator support, and comes with USB 3.1 gen 2 type-C and 2x USB 3.0 ports for maximum compatibility, efficient cooling, and easy connectivity.

items.title: Proven Performance
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully built to deliver balanced, reliable performance for gaming, creative work, and everyday tasks. Each system undergoes extended testing to ensure stability and longevity, even after years of intense usage.

items.title: Backed by Warranty
items.description: We stand behind our gaming computers with an unrivaled, 3 year parts and lifetime labor Ironside Warranty at no additional charge.

items.title: Shipped with Care
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully packaged to arrive safely at your door. We use double boxing and custom internal packaging to keep components secure during transit, so your system arrives exactly as intended.

items.title: Built by Family. Powered by Passion.
items.description: We’re more than a gaming PC company. We’re a family. Founded by four siblings, Ironside has always been a personal project, built with love, care, and respect for craftsmanship. What started in a Las Vegas garage is now a company still run with the same hands-on spirit and attention to detail.
